assertions: The report UI renders the immutable reviewable draft with its Finding recommendations and Evidence citations.
An Operator can submit one terminal ACCEPTED, EDITED, or REJECTED review and sees the persisted terminal result.
Editorial controls cannot alter model factual identities or Evidence citations.
A failed draft keeps its redacted history visible and offers an explicit new-attempt action.
The new-attempt action uses a fresh Idempotency-Key and never presents automatic retry or fallback behavior.
